description: Poll widget whose DOM is built entirely at runtime.
defects: Item names are interpolated with innerHTML, so the 'Gamma' entry renders as markup instead of text.
Vote controls are div elements: no keyboard access and no accessible name.
A document-level click listener and a 1-second setInterval are never removed; there is no teardown.
Global *, body and li selectors leak into the host page; the 480px fixed width overflows at 360px.
prompt_suffix: This widget builds its DOM at runtime. Render all item names as text (the third item must display literally as Gamma), make each vote control a real button with the accessible name 'Vote for ', keep the root element class 'widget', scope the CSS to the widget, avoid fixed widths that overflow a 360px viewport, and expose window.pollWidget.destroy() that clears the interval and removes every listener the widget added.
